analysis.overall: It was a bit of a roller-coaster day with a post-lunch peak and a late-evening low that rebounded overnight, but your readings smoothed out nicely by morning.

events.title: Post-lunch high
events.description: Glucose peaked at 228 mg/dL three hours after lunch, requiring several small corrections to bring it back down.

events.title: Post-dinner low
events.description: Insulin outpaced carb absorption after dinner, driving glucose down to a low of 65 mg/dL.

events.title: Midnight rebound rise
events.description: Sugars rebounded sharply to 229 mg/dL around midnight, likely from treating the low or delayed carb digestion.

events.title: Brief early-morning bump
events.description: A quick rise up to 203 mg/dL was promptly caught with corrections, clearing the way for a smooth rest of the night.

events.title: Pump site change & smooth morning
events.description: Following a mid-morning pump site change and profile switch, glucose stayed very steady in range through noon.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Keep an eye on post-dinner insulin timing to avoid a sharp dip followed by a midnight rebound.
